label: RV-EV-02
command_argv:
set -euo pipefail
printf "MAIN_HEAD="; git rev-parse HEAD
printf "WEBSHOP_HEAD="; git -C local_sources/third_party/webshop rev-parse HEAD
printf "WEBSHOP_STATUS_BEGIN\n"; git -C local_sources/third_party/webshop status --short; printf "WEBSHOP_STATUS_END\n"
/mnt/d/SoftWare/Anaconda/install/Scripts/conda.exe run -n webshop38 python --version
/mnt/d/SoftWare/Anaconda/install/Scripts/conda.exe run -n webshop38 java -version
python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root=Path("local_sources/third_party/webshop")
expected={
"items_shuffle_1000.json":(4467013,"30a4765c3a327af72d9a9a95a6b2486d516f0fa1d3ecd83681901ce82a21b269","list",1000),
"items_ins_v2_1000.json":(147099,"f88a36314a397b53b3d9c3fa5878e5f7b26d35019a51ec83fbedeca61a948f6f","dict",1000),
"items_human_ins.json":(5137548,"cf78667548a71786e1d9049c24b802e48e1084ad4bb021cae56ce1f6d96954a3","dict",10136),
}
for name,wanted in expected.items():
    p=root/"data"/name
    b=p.read_bytes(); obj=json.loads(b)
    actual=(len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),type(obj).__name__,len(obj))
    print("ASSET",name,actual,"MATCH",actual==wanted)
    assert actual==wanted
allowed={"resources_1k","indexes_1k"}
se=root/"search_engine"
for p in sorted(se.iterdir()):
    if p.is_dir() and (p.name.startswith("resources") or p.name.startswith("indexes")):
        print("SEARCH_DIR",p.name)
        assert p.name in allowed, p
idx=list((se/"indexes_1k").iterdir())
print("INDEX_FILE_COUNT",len(idx)); assert idx
r=se/"resources_1k"/"documents.jsonl"
lines=sum(1 for _ in r.open(encoding="utf-8"))
print("RESOURCE_LINES",lines); assert lines==1000
for path in [Path("scripts/validation/webshop/bootstrap_webshop_small.ps1"),Path("scripts/validation/webshop/verify_webshop_small_assets.py"),Path("scripts/validation/webshop/smoke_webshop_small.py"),Path("tests/test_webshop_small_runtime_contract.py")]:
    print("TRACKED_SHA",path,hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
bootstrap=Path("scripts/validation/webshop/bootstrap_webshop_small.ps1").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "AllowChecksumMirrorFallback" in bootstrap
assert "resolve/main/" not in bootstrap
assert "ce990fff5aee388db2706f07820c578ab68e0453" in bootstrap
smoke=Path("scripts/validation/webshop/smoke_webshop_small.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
assert "step(" + chr(34) + "click[buy now]" + chr(34) + ")" not in smoke
print("STATIC_FAIL_CLOSED_PASS=True")
PY
